spec.description: Per-container CPU, memory, network and disk.

spec.title: Memory cached
spec.description: File data the kernel holds for the container. Reclaimable under memory pressure, so a high value is not itself a shortage.

spec.title: CPU usage
spec.description: CPU time as a share of one core: 250% is 2.5 cores.

One row per container.
- `CPU %` and `Memory` are averaged over the range; every other column is the latest sample.
- `Memory` is anonymous memory, while `Memory Limit` is enforced against the larger working set: a container can be killed with `Memory` reading low.
- `Restarts` counts in-place restarts and recreations.

spec.expr:
sum by (name, host) (changes(container_start_time_seconds{host=~"$hostname", container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"$project",  name=~"$container", name=~".+"}[${__range}]))
+ (count by (name, host) (count_over_time(container_start_time_seconds{host=~"$hostname", container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"$project",  name=~"$container", name=~".+"}[${__range}])) - 1)

2 * (container_health_state{host=~"$hostname", container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"$project",  name=~"$container", name=~".+"} == bool 0) + (container_health_state{host=~"$hostname", container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"$project",  name=~"$container", name=~".+"} == bool 1)

spec.title: Disk I/O
spec.description: Reads above the axis, writes below. A container idle for the whole range is dropped from the legend.

spec.title: CPU utilization
spec.description: The same CPU time divided by the cores the selected hosts have, so it cannot exceed 100%.

spec.title: Memory utilization
spec.description: Container anonymous memory against the selected hosts' total RAM. Page cache and everything the host uses outside containers fall outside the numerator, so this reads below what the host reports.

spec.title: Total network I/O
spec.description: Receive and transmit added together.

spec.title: Container writable layer
spec.description: Only the copy-on-write layer. Volumes, bind mounts and tmpfs live elsewhere and are not counted.

spec.title: Unhealthy
spec.description:
Containers failing a healthcheck now.
- cAdvisor reports `starting` and `unhealthy` as one value, so the window after a restart counts here.
- Containers that define no healthcheck are never counted.

spec.title: Total disk I/O
spec.description: Reads and writes added together.

spec.title: CPU usage
spec.description: CPU time as a share of one core: 250% is 2.5 cores.

spec.title: Memory usage
spec.description: Anonymous memory: heap and stacks. Page cache and the container's own resident binary pages fall outside it, so a container whose footprint is mostly cache reads low.

spec.title: Network traffic
spec.description: Receive above the axis, transmit below. A container idle for the whole range is dropped from the legend.

spec.title: Network traffic
spec.description: Receive above the axis, transmit below. A container idle for the whole range is dropped from the legend.

spec.title: Disk I/O
spec.description: Reads above the axis, writes below. A container idle for the whole range is dropped from the legend.

spec.title: CPU usage
spec.description: CPU time as a share of one core: 250% is 2.5 cores.

spec.title: Memory usage
spec.description: Anonymous memory across the selected containers: heap and stacks, with page cache outside it.

spec.title: Memory refaults
spec.description:
Pages evicted under memory pressure and then needed again; sustained values mean the working set does not fit in memory.

- `anon` — swap-backed, severe
- `file` — page cache, milder

spec.title: Memory refaults
spec.description:
Pages evicted under memory pressure and then needed again; sustained values mean the working set does not fit in memory.

- `anon` — swap-backed, severe
- `file` — page cache, milder

spec.title: Dirty / writeback
spec.description:
Page-cache backlog waiting on the disk. Growing values mean writes outpace it.

- `dirty` — modified, not yet written
- `writeback` — currently flushing

spec.title: Dirty / writeback
spec.description:
Page-cache backlog waiting on the disk. Growing values mean writes outpace it.

- `dirty` — modified, not yet written
- `writeback` — currently flushing

Containers not healthy at some point in the range, longest first.
- cAdvisor reports `starting` and `unhealthy` as one value, so the window after a restart earns a lane.

spec.expr:
sum by (host, name) (sum_over_time((container_health_state{host=~"$hostname", container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"$project", name=~"$container", name=~".+"} == bool 0)[$__interval:1m] offset -$__interval))
* on (host, name) group_left (_sort)
count_values by (host, name) ("_sort", 1e6 - (sum by (host, name) (sum_over_time((container_health_state{host=~"$hostname", container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"$project", name=~"$container", name=~".+"} == bool 0)[$__range:1m] @ end())) > 0))

spec.title: $image
spec.description:
Containers on each tag of one image, stacked to the image total; one panel per image that ran more than one tag in the range.
- Version: the tag of `image`; a new digest under the same tag is the same version.
- A one-step spike: a recreated container, counted under both its old and new series.

spec.query: query_result(count by (repo) (count by (repo, tag) (label_replace(label_replace(count_over_time(container_last_seen{host=~"$hostname", container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"$project", name=~"$container", name=~".+"}[$__range]), "repo", "$1", "image", "([^@]*?)(:[^:/@]*)?(@.*)?"), "tag", "$1", "image", "[^@]*:([^:/@]+)(@.*)?"))) > 1)
